people.name: Mr. Rakesh Kumar Rajput
people.evidence_quote: Accordingly, Mr. Rajput has completed his tenure as the Chief Compliance Officer of the Bank from the close of business hours on September 30, 2026.
people.tenure_quote: for a period of 3 (three) years, ending September 30, 2026.

people.name: Mr. V. N. Srivatsan
people.evidence_quote: We wish to inform you that based on the recommendations of the Audit Committee and the Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Board of Directors of the Bank at its meeting held today i.e. on September 30, 2026, has approved the appointment of Mr. V. N. Srivatsan as the Chief Compliance Officer of the Bank, as per the provisions of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks- Compliance Function) Directions, 2026, for a period of 3 (three) years, with effect from his date of joining.
people.tenure_quote: Term: 3 (three) years from the date of joining.
people.bio_quote: Mr. V.  N. Srivatsan has approximately 34 years of overall professional experience, including around 25 years in the BFSI sector and close to 10 years of direct experience in Compliance and Regulatory Inspection. He currently serves as Head – Compliance: Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer at ICICI Bank Limited.

people.name: Mr. Venkateswaran L
people.evidence_quote: During the intervening period, Mr. Venkateswaran L, currently Compliance Head - Credit, Asset Product & Regulatory Reporting, shall hold the responsibility as the Chief Compliance Officer.
